verses: And David and the captains of the host separated for the service certain of the sons of Asaf, and of Heman, and of Yedutun, who should prophesy with lyres, with lutes, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
of the sons of Asaf; Zekhur, and Yosef, and Netanya, and Asar᾽ela, the sons of Asaf, under the hands of Asaf, who prophesied according to the order of the king.

Of Yedutun: the sons of Yedutun; Gedalyahu, and Żeri, and Yesha῾yahu, Ḥashavyahu, and Mattityahu; six, under the hands of their father Yedutun, who prophesied with a lyre, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.
Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Buqqiyyahu, Mattanyahu, ῾Uzzi᾽el, Shevu᾽el, and Yerimot, Ḥananya, Ḥanani, Eli᾽ata, Giddalti, and Romamti-῾ezer, Yoshbeqasha, Malloti, Hotir, and Maĥazi᾽ot:
all these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer according to the word of God, who bade to lift up his horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, lutes, and lyres, for the service of the house of God, according to the king’s order      Asaf, Yedutun, and Heman.
So the number of them, with their brethren who were instructed in the songs of the Lord, all who were skilful, was two hundred and eighty eight.
And they cast lots, watch against watch, the small and the great alike, the teacher together with the pupil.
Now the first lot came out for Asaf to Yosef: the second to Gedalyahu; he with his brethren and sons were twelve:
the third to Zakkur, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
the fourth to Yiżri, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the fifth to Netanyahu, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the sixth to Buqqiyyahu, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the seventh to Yesar᾽ela, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
the eighth to Yesha῾yahu, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the ninth to Mattanyahu, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the tenth to Shim῾i, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the eleventh to ῾Azar᾽el, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the twelfth to Ḥashavya, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the thirteenth to Shuva᾽el, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the fourteenth to Mattityahu, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the fifteenth to Yeremot, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the sixteenth, to Ḥananyahu, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the seventeenth to Yoshbeqasha, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the eighteenth to Ḥanani, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the nineteenth to Malloti, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the twentieth to Eliyyata, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the twenty first to Hotir, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the twenty second to Giddalti, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the twenty third to Maĥazi᾽ot, his sons, and his brethren, twelve:
the twenty fourth to Romamti-῾ezer, his sons, and his brethren, twelve.
